kammakkhaya.cp: masc. consummation of the previous actions and the results thereof.
kammakkhaya.p: [Kamma+khaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) Exhaustion of Kamma. (2) Arahattaphala that is an exhaustion of Kamma.

(၁)ကံကုန်ခြင်း။(၂)ကံကုန်ရာဖြစ်သော အရဟတ္တဖိုလ်။

[ကမ္မ+ခယ]
（၁） ကံကုန်ခြင်း။ （၂） ကံကုန်ရာဖြစ်သော အရဟတ္တဖိုလ်။

kammakkhaya：ကမ္မ-က္ခယ （ပ）
ကုသိုလ်ကံ အကုသိုလ်ကံ ကုန်ခြင်း။
CPD: kamma-kkhaya , m. [ Buddh. sa. karmakṣaya], anni- hilation of kamma; — exeg.: ~āya saṃvattati ayaṃ nibbedho, Nett 159, 10 ; — in formula describing four types of kamma, on which, cf. 3 kamma b.(ii): atth' āvuso kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ ... ~āya saṃvattati, D lll 230, 5 ; — on ~ as the presupposition of the destruction of suffering: taṇhakkhayā ~o ~ā dukkhakkhayo ti, S V 87, 3 ; — in reproduction of the niggaṇṭha Nathaputta's view on kamma on which, cf. 3 kamma g.: āyatiṃ ana- vassavā ~o, ~ā dukkhakkhayo +, M l 93, 7,8 = ll 214, 11 = 220, 5 ≠ A l 221, 1 (~ā dukkhakkhayo ti kam- mavaṭṭakkhayena dukkhavaṭṭakkhayo, Mp ll 332, 13 ); — taṃ khandhānaṃ mūlabhūtaṃ bhava- saṅkhāraṃ kammaṃ ~āya saṃvattatī ti evaṃ vut- tena kammakkhayakarena ariyamaggena avassaji, Sv 557, 35 ( ad D ll 107, 3 : bhavasaṅkhāraṃ avassajjī muni) = Spk lll 254, 34 ( ad S V 263, 2 ) = Mp lV 154, 9 ( ad A lV 312, 1 ) = Ud-a 329, 27 ( ad Ud 64, 29 ); — mag- gacetanā ... sa ... ~āya saṃvattatī ti, Mp lll 213, 11 ( ad A ll 232, 12 ); kammabalena yāva ~ā na cavantā tiṭṭhante ( i.e. in the Avici hell ), Ss 141, 13 ; — ifc. kusa- lâkusala- ° (Mp V 52, 23 ); sabba- ° (S l 134, 4 ; Ap 460, 18 ; lt 123, 3* ; ~-ppatta, Spk l 193, 20 ; ~-saṅkhāta, Spk l 193, 20 ).[[side 225]]

CPD: kamma-kkhama , mfn., capable of, fit for action; used in glosses on kammaniya and kammañña, qq.v.; muduttā yeva ca kammaniye (Vin lll 4, 19 scil. citte), ~e kammayogge ti vuttaṃ hoti, Vism 377, 6 = Sp 157, 19 ; Nett-a 148, 29 ; ~aṃ kammayoggan ti kamma- niyaṃ ... tasmiṃ alaṃ kammaniye, Sp 631, 24 qu. Kkh 52, 12 ; Paṭis-a 345, 9 ; Mp l 52, 4 ( ad A l 5, 9 ); kam- mañña ti ~ā kammayoggā, Mp lll 389, 8 ; kammañña ti ~ā, Sp 1081, 22 ( ad Vin l 182, 31,34 ; = kammayoggā, Sp-ṭ lll 291, 12 ); ~e ti vikubbanâdi-iddhikammak- khame, Vism-mhṭ ll 7, 7 qu. Sp-ṭ l 384, 18 ; — ifc. sab- ba- ° (Mp l 246, 25 ).

kammakkhandhaka.p: [Kamma+khandhaka] (pu) CL=7 Khandhaka (Mahāvagga and Cūḷavagga, two books of the Vinaya Piṭaka) that criticizes Kamma such as Tajjanīya (concerning a rebuke; (a formal act of the saṅgha) expressing a rebuke).
